findings.fixed_budget: _GOAL_TAG_CELLS = 8 (local_operator/tui/widgets/goal_panel.py:79), subtracted from the goal clip at line ~268
findings.text: The goal row is clipped to `inner - 2 - 8` and the tag is appended AFTER the clip, so a 9-cell tag makes the row one cell wider than the card content box. Rendered at 100x40 in the real GoalPanel after pressing `d`: `▌ Migrar … con e…  —` then `hecho` on the next line. The tag splits, `hecho` is orphaned and the card grows from 8 to 9 rows (English: 1 line, 8 rows). The key hint row is still present in the frame; the defect is the split of the done state, the same D2 shape the constant comment records for English.
findings.suggested: Recommended: keep `  — hecho` (house two-space gutter and em dash per the sidecar) and raise `_GOAL_TAG_CELLS` from 8 to 9 in goal_panel.py:79 — a one-line code change; English then clips one cell sooner. If no code change is allowed: `  —hecho` (8 cells) drops one gutter space and breaks the sidecar rule.
